notes.title: 2024 Optimization Report
notes.content:

notes.title: [Announcement] Nonschedulrd Update / Discount (2021/09/27 update)
notes.content:
[h1]Discount history: [/h1]

[h2]Discount time: 2021/01/01~2021/01/14[/h2]
While celebrating the arrival of 2021, the new discount will be released on January 1, 2021, and the discount includes four indie games (three on Steam and one on Google Play) from the beginning of 2019 to the end of 2020. , The discount will last for two weeks. Interested players can also choose the package type below.
[h2]Discount time: 2021/06/24~2021/07/08[/h2]
Celebrating the birth of the new game "MOMIJI FROM PURGATORY" and in conjunction with Steam summer sale event, three independent games sold on Steam in the past simultaneously released discounts.
[h2]Discount time: 2021/09/17~2021/10/01[/h2]
The annual Mid-Autumn Festival holiday is coming soon, and all indie games sold on Steam in the past will be released with a half-price discount (for a period of two weeks)

[h1]Repair bug history: [/h1]

Hello, everyone, the follow-up update and error repair messages will be concentrated here, because some programs may be changed from time to time, new problems may arise. Once there is a problem, it will take another time to repair. Sorry for the inconvenience!

[h2]11/12[/h2]
Hello, everyone, because there are many bugs after the launch of Steam, although they have been eliminated one after another, but still worried that the player’s save will disappear, so added a new function "shortcut"
The shortcut point is located at: Start a new game> Enter the first picture of the game, next to the cherry blossom tree in garden, there are currently five shortcut points for player to choose (if the original file is still there, can ignore it)

Major bug fix process:
Reduce the protagonist's running speed (to avoid bursting through the wall)
Cancel the jump (to avoid bursting through the wall)
The stuck ladder will be added to the slope (new problems arising after reducing the speed)
Reduced the running speed of most monsters (new problems arising after reducing the speed)

[h2]11/13[/h2]
Other resolved or modified:
Stairs stuck in the old capital
Reduce the running speed of some monsters
Modify the ESC of the scene after one year
Reduce the protagonist's footsteps
Added the purple name of the chaser
Decrease pig attack power by 100>20
Reduce the speed of witch by 1.5>0.8

[h2]11/14[/h2]
After testing with friends, the reason for running speed rush is known: After changing the move code "Update" to "FixedUpdate", it returns to normal

[h2]11/15[/h2]
Fixed the black screen when pass to Chapter 6

[h2]11/16[/h2]
[strike]It is currently known that the trigger aperture event will be stuck[/strike] (Solved)
Reduce the number of rabbits 
Speed up the meal
Give more tips

[h2]11/18[/h2]
Fixed the sound of footsteps when pressing ESC
Update Yuro character module

[h2]11/23[/h2]
Change the BGM of "Greenery world"
Added the ability to skip the ending directly
The protagonist's running speed increased by 4 > 4.5

[h2]12/30[/h2]
Remake Yuro character module again
Solve the problem that the mouse will disappear
Add one achievement

[h2]From the starting point to the end point, you can pass all the level without pressure. If you don’t know how to go next, you can directly press ESC to view the strategy steps on the left. If you still have new questions, welcome to respond. For the first contact with bugs Players, I am deeply sorry![/h2]
